result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: truncated restaurant names in the horizontal carousel and overlapping delivery-time badges on food images.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word by the card/image edge, not only by the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure card width and text truncation (ellipsis) keep names readable.

issues.description: Delivery time badges (e.g. '15–25 min', '20–30 min') sit overlapping the bottom of the food images and can obscure the illustration.
issues.suggestion: Reposition badges below the image or add consistent padding/margin so they rest on a clear area without covering the artwork.
